analysis.title: DeskTalk - Markets absorb blue wave, green light for risk
key_insights: Risk sentiment picked up in the London morning after the Democrats were confirmed to have won a blue wave overnight. SPX e-minis are +0.7% at 7652. Citi's desks view the midterms as a clearing event with no change to near-term narratives.

Concern after the Democratic win in the Texas Senate and Governor races centered on a possible data center moratorium. Citi says the timing and likelihood of any such measure matter, and roadblocks may only appear from Jan 2027 when power changes hands. Until then, earnings and AI funding concerns stay in front.
AMD and ANET earnings reported last night were positive and should help tech sentiment intraday. Citi sees nothing yet to invalidate the typical year-end 'Santa rally'.
SPX e-minis next resistance is 7724 (50dMA). CTA positioning flips long at 7670 and reaches max long at 7765. For Nasdaq, resistance is 29674 (100dMA) and the CTA flip to long is not until 29908.
European equities continue to outperform. Citi's D1 desk prefers the CGDORBND Index, a basket of EU banks, semis and electrification names.

The UST rally has stalled and mostly reversed in the front end. Citi's macro strategist still expects a steeper curve, but the near-term focus is the QRA announcement at 13:30 GMT. Citi is out of consensus looking for $3bn cuts in 20y and 30y issuance, which could extend the rally.

Risk-correlated currencies bounced, with the antipodeans leading and ZAR rallying in line with gold. FX volumes are only marginally above 30-day averages. Leveraged accounts sold AUD and CNH against JPY and GBP, and real money was less active, though JPY buying against EUR stood out.

Citi's trader argues a local USD top may have been put in last week. US data remains the key support for the dollar, and downside surprises in growth indicators could quickly erode it. EURUSD remains a buy on dips, but 1.1260 has been hard to break.
Trump's willingness to work with the Democrats and confirmation of no near-term strikes on Iran are noted, though oil is only about 1% weaker. Citi says headlines remain worth watching.
AP has called 54 seats for the Democrats, with Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled. Results came faster than usual overnight, the first at 00:55 GMT for Georgia.

tension_points.bull_case: Markets can shift back to fundamentals, which should keep supporting risk assets. Fiscal and AI policy is more of a 2027 risk, AMD and ANET earnings were positive, and Citi sees nothing to invalidate the year-end Santa rally.
tension_points.bear_case: A Democratic win in the Texas Senate and Governor races raised concerns about a data center moratorium, and AI funding concerns remain in the forefront.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Roadblocks may eventually appear from Jan 2027 when power changes hands. For the dollar and growth support, downside surprises in US growth indicators would erode it.
